params.caption: 🎮 Suspect arrested after shooting at campus home to Xbox studio inXile Police in Tustin, California have arrested a suspect after a drive-by shooting at an office campus that houses inXile Entertainment, the Xbox-owned studio behind Wasteland and the upcoming Clockwork Revolution. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 20:47 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @Xbox 🙏 Stay safe, devs · 💬 Share your thoughts below #inXile #Xbox #GameDev #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
